description: This PHP source file defines a test class `ModulesCest` for API testing of the /api/v8/modules endpoints in a SuiteCRM project. It includes numerous test scenarios for CRUD operations, relationships, filtering, and resource handling, primarily targeting modules like Accounts, Notes, Documents, Products, and related resources. The class utilizes the Codeception testing framework with methods for HTTP requests, response assertions, and data setup.

classes.name: ModulesCest
classes.description: A test class for SuiteCRM modules API. Contains various scenarios to test CRUD, relationship management, filtering, and other API functionalities for module resources such as Accounts, Notes, Documents, Products, and related entities.

methods.name: _before
methods.description: Setup method executed before each test, initializes Faker data generator and seeds random data.

methods.name: TestScenarioListModules
methods.description: Test listing all available modules via /api/v8/modules/meta/list endpoint and verifying the response structure.

methods.name: TestScenarioCreateWithMissingType
methods.description: Test failure when creating a resource without specifying type.

methods.name: TestScenarioCreateWithMissingAttributes
methods.description: Test failure on resource creation when required attributes are missing.

methods.name: TestScenarioCreateWithMissingRequiredFields
methods.description: Test failure when creating a resource with missing required fields.

methods.name: TestScenarioCreateNew
methods.description: Test creating a new Account resource with valid data, storing its ID.

methods.name: TestScenarioCreateNewWithClientCredentialsGrant
methods.description: Test creating a new Account resource with client credentials authentication, storing its ID.

methods.name: TestScenarioCreateExisting
methods.description: Test attempting to create a resource with an existing ID, expecting failure.

methods.name: TestScenarioCreateNoteWithAttachment
methods.description: Create a Note resource with file attachment, verify creation and retrieval with correct data, store resource ID.

methods.name: TestScenarioCreateDocumentWithAttachment
methods.description: Create a Document resource with file attachment, verify creation and retrieval with correct data, store resource ID.

methods.name: TestScenarioRetrieveEntry
methods.description: Retrieve specific Account entry by ID and verify response contents.

methods.name: TestScenarioUpdateEntry
methods.description: Update an existing Account resource's name attribute, verify update.

methods.name: TestScenarioDeleteEntry
methods.description: Delete an Account resource by ID and verify response.

methods.name: TestScenarioRetrieveList
methods.description: Retrieve list of Accounts and verify response structure and contents.

methods.name: TestScenarioRetrieveFilteredList
methods.description: Retrieve filtered list of Accounts with date filter, verify response.

methods.name: TestScenarioCreateProductWithAnOneToManyRelationship
methods.description: Create a ProductCategory, then create a Product linked to that category, verifying responses.

methods.name: TestScenarioRetrieveOneToManyRelationship
methods.description: Retrieve relationship for a Product to its ProductCategory, verify related data.

methods.name: TestScenarioCreateAnOneToManyRelationship
methods.description: Create a new ProductCategory and relate it to an existing Product, verify relation.

methods.name: TestScenarioUpdateOneToManyRelationship
methods.description: Create a new ProductCategory and update the Product to relate to it, verify relation.

methods.name: TestScenarioClearOneToManyRelationshipUsingRelationshipLink
methods.description: Clear Product's relationship to ProductCategory using the relationship link, verify removal.

methods.name: TestScenarioDeleteOneToManyRelationship
methods.description: Create and then delete Product-ProductCategory relationship, verify deletion.

methods.name: TestScenarioCreateManyToManyRelationships
methods.description: Create multiple Products, create a ProductCategory, then relate Products to category in many-to-many fashion.

methods.name: TestScenarioRetrieveManyToManyRelationships
methods.description: Retrieve a ProductCategory's related Products and verify correctness.

methods.name: TestScenarioUpdateManyToManyRelationships
methods.description: Replace a ProductCategory's related Products with a subset, verify updated relation.

methods.name: TestScenarioClearManyToManyRelationships
methods.description: Clear all related Products from a ProductCategory, verify emptiness.

methods.name: TestScenarioDeleteManyToManyRelationships
methods.description: Create a separate set of Products and relate to a category, then remove one Product from relation, verify.

methods.name: TestScenarioCreateMeetingsWithUsersAndMiddleTableFields
methods.description: Commented out: Intended to test creating meetings with user relationships and middle table data.
